summary: Phase 3 additions fully verified. Backend: 24/24 pytest tests pass (5 new phase-3 tests + 19 regression, existing suite updated to new seed v10 baselines: 78 cards/lessons, 6 quiz questions). New endpoints validated: GET /api/quizzes/{id} returns 6 questions with question_type and image_url fields (match_image, reversed_detect, keyword_pick, match_meaning, mcq); GET /api/achievements returns {total:15, unlocked:int, items:[...]} with progress/pct/target/unlocked fields (auth-gated); POST /api/quizzes/submit response now includes perfect, xp_streak_bonus, achievements_unlocked. Perfect submission (via option-scan probe) returns xp_earned>=25 (base 20 + 10 perfect bonus) and unlocks first_lesson achievement. Streak bonus is 0 for first day (streak=1, tier begins at 3). Frontend (390x844 mobile): login as seeker@mystic.app works, onboarding SKIP works, Progress tab shows Achievements section with all 15 tiles and 'X / 15 Unlocked' header (first_lesson present), Card detail shows single flippable card with testID='flip-card' — tapping rotates the card 180deg and flips image upside-down with 'REVERSED' tag, hint updates to 'tap card to flip · reversed'. Quiz screen advances through 6 questions and displays 4 different UI variants (QUESTION for mcq/match_meaning, IMAGE MATCH with card image, ORIENTATION with up/down arrows, KEYWORD as pills). Progress bar animates as questions advance. Result screen renders with StreakBadge, XP Earned, Level. No React Native red screens; only minor legacy web-compat warnings (shadow*/pointerEvents deprecations already noted in iteration 1). No deprecated Expo packages detected.
